claim_boundary: This boundary records the publication gate for ROADMAP readiness percentages. It does not claim requirement-level source-span mapping, canonical underlying-gap deduplication, per-category code/test/runtime-artifact proof maps, benchmark reproduction certification, operational release-readiness gate, readiness uncertainty labels, stale-count detector, or a policy allowing weighted TODO completion to be published as semantic AlphaEvolve implementation parity.
